CREATURES.action: Thriving in absolute harmony across the sun-drenched terraced green pastures of their mountain sanctuary
CREATURES.gaze: Peaceful activities spread across the boundless slopes

ENVIRONMENT.camera: Macro tilt-shift, grand wide panoramic orbital establishing shot rising and slowly pulling back into the glowing golden morning sky to reveal the entire magnificent folk-art diorama world in timeless peace
ENVIRONMENT.setting: The supreme ancient summit of the Scottish Borders pasture overlooking infinite sweeping green valleys, dry-stone walls, and the distant cottage

focal_elements.item: Ancient summit cairn with standing ash crook
focal_elements.material: Stacked miniature slate boulders crowned with living heather
focal_elements.details: An eternal monument to quiet devotion, companionship, and stewardship on the high hills

ENVIRONMENT.staging: figure_1 and creature_1 stationed on the summit knoll in foreground-left; creature_2 flock and playful puppies spread across midground; vast panoramic valleys and winding dry-stone walls stretching to the glowing horizon
ENVIRONMENT.real_nature: Real mountain cushion moss, living miniature heather bells, slate stones, real turf
ENVIRONMENT.backdrop: Infinite layered mountain ridges of the Scottish Southern Uplands bathed in radiant, warm golden atmospheric light
ENVIRONMENT.lighting: Luminous, golden-amber morning sunlight bathing the entire landscape, making every wool fiber, stone facet, and blade of grass glow with warmth
ENVIRONMENT.motion: A slow, majestic panoramic camera drift rising up and pulling back as cloud shadows glide gracefully across the vast green valley

SURREAL.description: The entire panoramic diorama gently rests atop an enormous ancient hand-carved wooden worktable whose carved edges blend seamlessly into the horizon

ANIMATION.prompt: Alive Surreal World, smooth wide panoramic glide. Camera slowly rises and pulls back into the golden morning sky to reveal the elderly shepherd, his faithful dog, and the entire peaceful pastoral world thriving in timeless harmony.
